verdict.rationale: React is distributed as open source on GitHub. It is installed locally via npm and build tools such as Vite, Parcel or Rsbuild, and the resulting apps can be deployed to any CDN or static host without a server. Server rendering runs on your own Node environment. So the core product runs entirely on infrastructure the user controls, and community discussion confirms its relicensing to MIT. Missing for 10: a first-party statement of the license terms (MIT is evidenced only via community threads), explicit first-party documentation framing self-hosting or vendoring of the library itself.
